name: x-scanner
description: Chrome extension that labels every post you scroll past on X using TypeSafe's Jev, with a live cost counter in the corner.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f x-scanner-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../x-scanner-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '.DS_Store' && cd .. && ls -la x-scanner-$npm_package_version.zip
